annotations.title: Parse and classify an IPv4/IPv6 address (private, loopback, CGNAT, documentation

description: Parse and classify an IPv4/IPv6 address (private, loopback, CGNAT, documentation, ...). Canonical and expanded forms, integer and hex values, version, scope per the IANA special-purpose registries (private, loopback, link-local, CGNAT, multicast, documentation, 6to4, NAT64, IPv4-mapped with the embedded address), whether it is globally routable, and the reverse-DNS name. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
